answer.original_source: NN, Inc., as reported by finance.yahoo.com. The announcement date is described as late June 2026; no exact original publication day is provided.
answer.new_information: NN announced an expansion of liquid-cooling production at its Wuxi, China plant, adding 47 machine centers for production tied to NVIDIA AI data-center racks. The accompanying article also reports that all new capacity was pre-sold under multi-year, multi-product awards and that NN targeted US$80–US$90 million of accretive new business in 2026. These are NN supplier-capacity and business-target claims, not evidence of NVIDIA shipments, revenue, or a change to an existing NVIDIA question. No questions or stored pieces were supplied to update.

The capacity and 2026 business target concern NN, Inc.; they do not establish realized sales or financial impact for NVIDIA.
